title: Exact learner recovers the target
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $k$ be a natural number. If the number of nonzero Fourier coefficients of the corresponding function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ is at most $2^{k+1}$, then the hypothesis returned by the exact sparse spectrum learner, when evaluated on the sign cube, equals $f$ at every input.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
The spectral sparsity of the corresponding function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ is at most $2^{k+1}$
